components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action for creating a practice space or starting practice.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 3rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); padding: .75rem 1.25rem; font: 500 .875rem/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary), var(--foreground) 12%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action such as Sign in, View progress, or Another prompt.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; min-height: 3rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: .5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); padding: .75rem; font: 500 .875rem/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A role or setup field that keeps the form quiet and legible.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .5rem; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 .875rem/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); padding: .625rem .75rem; font: 400 1rem/1.75 var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: border-color 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 140ms ease-out; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring), transparent 70%); } .ds-field input:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Editorial Card
components.description: A bounded work surface for setup, interview state, or truthful completion copy.
components.html:
Interview details

Choose a few details for this practice room.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground), transparent 90%); border-radius: .75rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); padding: 1.25rem; font: 400 1rem/1.75 var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-card p { margin: .25rem 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation Rail
components.description: Persistent labeled navigation for Home, Interview, Progress, and Settings.
components.html: HomeInterview
components.css: .ds-nav-rail { display: grid; width: 15rem; min-height: 14rem; gap: .25rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--sidebar); padding: 1.25rem 1rem; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; border-left: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: .5rem; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sidebar-foreground), transparent 30%); padding: .75rem; text-decoration: none; font: 500 .875rem/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-foreground); } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { border-left-color: var(--sidebar-primary); color: var(--sidebar-foreground); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sidebar-accent), transparent 30%); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sidebar-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mobile Navigation
components.description: Four labeled bottom destinations with a safe-area-aware touch target.
components.html: HomeProgress
components.css: .ds-nav-mobile { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .25rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--background); padding: .5rem .75rem max(.5rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); } .ds-nav-mobile-item { display: flex; min-height: 3rem; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .125rem; border-radius: .5rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration: none; font: 500 .6875rem/1.3 var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-mobile-item svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; } .ds-nav-mobile-item:hover, .ds-nav-mobile-item.ds-active { background: var(--accent); color: var(--primary); } .ds-nav-mobile-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Warm-up Prompt
components.description: Optional local preparation that supports practice without competing with the primary CTA.
components.html:
OPTIONAL WARM-UP

Tell me about a technical decision you made with incomplete information.

Start with the constraint, then name the trade-off you chose.
components.css: .ds-warmup { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 1.5rem 0; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-warmup-label { margin: 0; color: var(--primary); font: 500 .6875rem/1.3 var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-warmup-question { margin: 1.25rem 0 0; font: 500 .875rem/1.75 var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-warmup-cue { margin: .75rem 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 .875rem/1.75 var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-warmup .ds-btn-ghost { margin-top: 1.25rem; padding-left: 0; }

narrative.overview:
English Interview Agent is an editorial operating surface for a high-pressure human task. The interface gives a candidate one useful next move, using warm bone surfaces, ink-colored type, sparse hairline rules, and a precise blue-green accent. It feels like a prepared desk: quiet, legible, and ready when the question arrives.

The visual system favors hierarchy over decoration. Public Home makes the audience and promise clear before offering one account action; authenticated Home keeps one practice action in front, with warm-up and Progress as supporting paths. The implementation rejects gradients, heavy shadows, generic bento grids, decorative avatars, and claims the product cannot support.
keyCharacteristics: Warm monochrome canvas with a single muted teal action voice.
Editorial rules, narrow measures, and deliberate whitespace.
Controls are modestly rounded, tactile, and visibly focusable.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Let the accent carry action and current-location meaning; do not spread it across decorative surfaces.

rules.name: The Clear Answer Rule
rules.body: Use tight, weight-led headings and readable measures; never use display scale to make a promise sound louder than it is.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat; use a rule, spacing, or tonal shift to establish hierarchy before adding elevation.

dos: Do keep one primary CTA in the first viewport: “Create a practice space” publicly or “Start practice” for an authenticated candidate.
Do use the accent for action, focus, and current location, with Hairline Rules for structure.
Do keep explanatory copy within roughly 48–60ch and let long roles or statuses wrap.
Do preserve visible focus, labeled navigation, 44px-or-larger touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do let warm-up and Progress support the next action without inventing metrics or analysis claims.
donts: Don't add gradients, neon, glass, heavy shadows, decorative avatars, or generic bento/card grids.
Don't use accent color as a saturated background for every navigation item or section.
Don't make primary actions pill-shaped, icon-only, or dependent on hover to explain themselves.
Don't claim AI analysis, readiness scores, accent correction, or outcomes not represented by the product.
Don't duplicate Progress metrics, history, loading, error, or empty states on Home.
